_note: One Baidu photo of the terminal forecourt joins the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

maa-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，金奈国际机场（MAA）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
maa-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Chennai International Airport (MAA) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

maa-baidu-1.webp.zh: 金奈机场航站楼前的落客区：白色尖顶雨棚一字排开，出租车排队候客，右侧有高架桥穿过。
maa-baidu-1.webp.en: The forecourt of Chennai's terminal, its row of white peaked canopies above queued taxis, with an elevated viaduct passing on the right.
